output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: Convert each witness's times to true time using their clock's offset. Rosa's kitchen clock is 15 minutes fast. Girard's watch is 4 minutes slow. Félix's watch is 20 minutes slow. The salon clock is 5 minutes slow. Girard heard the repeater at 10:34 by his watch, which is 22:38 true, while the piano was playing. Félix heard the thump at 10:18 by his watch, which is also 22:38 true. The piano ran from 22:33 to 22:46 true. Rosa and Lina confirm this: 10:48 to 11:01 on the kitchen clock is 22:33 to 22:46 true. Odile says the doctor left the salon at 10:28 by the salon clock, which is 22:33 true, just as the piano began. He came back when the piano stopped, at about 22:46. So the doctor was out of the salon during the blow, and Odile was at the piano. The doctor lied when he said he left at a quarter to eleven. Lina and Rosa were in the kitchen together, Félix was in the library, and Girard was in the street. Only the doctor had the opportunity. The regulator stopped at 10:05 was a false clue.
